# Benjamin Cable - darkmage.dev

Personal CV site of Benjamin Cable, Senior Backend Engineer (Go) at LootLocker.
Site: https://darkmage.dev

- https://darkmage.dev/cv.json - structured CV data (machine-readable; source of truth for the site)
- https://darkmage.dev/cv.html - plain HTML CV (recruiter/ATS friendly, print to PDF)
- https://darkmage.dev/ - themed CV page
